label: miso 50 coalsigmoid ablation
definition: Rule-20 zero-forcing ablation twin of 2026-07-09-miso-50-coalsigmoid (the MISO coal-sigmoid re-derive probe): same recipe with ALL commitment/forcing floors OFF. Result is near-identical to the main run -- COAL_PRB +30.60->+30.65, COAL_BIT +13.88->+13.91, 2024 COAL_PRB +27.06->+27.22 TWh -- confirming the coal-for-gas over-substitution the re-derive produces is 100% ECONOMIC merit (the measured cheap coal offer), NOT floor-forcing (C8 independently reads COAL 0.1-0.2% forced). This is the rule-20 evidence that the discovered coal over-run is a real gas-side / daily-basin-spot-granularity root cause, not a forcing artifact. Diagnostic reference, not a keeper. See docs/handoffs/coal-sigmoid-rederive-2026-07.md.
